title: Platinum Rewards Card: Price Protection
content:
## Coverage

- If an item bought with the Platinum Rewards Card is advertised at a lower price within 60 days of purchase, the cardholder can claim the difference as a statement credit.

## Claim Limits

- Maximum credit per item: $500.
- Maximum of 6 claims per calendar year.

## Processing (Internal)

- Confirm the purchase in the customer's credit card transactions and the lower advertised price the customer reports.
- Apply the difference, up to the per-item maximum, with apply_statement_credit_8472, reason 'price_match'.
